lessons_used: Sign-in reordering to post-adoption (+13.3%) or post-certificate (+5.8%), account recovery copy (+4.2%), and multi-device sync banners (+2.7%) worked; post-waiting sign-in hurt (-3.9%), while other sync hints had no clear effect.

Path selection clarity headlines (+5.9%), spotlight layouts (+2.7%), and visual redesigns (+5.9%) worked; checklist layouts hurt (-2.1%), while copy simplifications, value refreshes, time banners, and showcase layouts showed no clear effect.

Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%), readiness/visibility status checks (+3.3%, +4.7%), and spawn location hints (+4.5%) worked; 3D progress trackers, completion timers, sound notifications, and spawn alerts showed no clear effect.

Companion previews paired with quality guides (+7.6%) or split upload layouts (+8.1%) worked; compact grids (-7.7%), photo fallback flows (-11.8%), quality guidelines banners (-5.0%), and mascot stamp redesigns (-24.1%) hurt results.

Interactive spawn placement flows (+6.2%) and system tray location tips (+3.8%) worked; direct controls guides (-14.4%) and first interaction tips (-6.5%) hurt results, while mascot greeting stages and docking hints showed no clear effect.
Predictions underpredicted major wins (spawn placement flows, visual redesigns, headline updates) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (mascot stamp redesigns, direct controls guides).

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Pet Sync Notice
candidates.change: Add an explicit account synchronization notice on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets and progress will be recovered upon signing in.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again; explicit copy reassures users before they log in.

sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your desktop pet synced across devices. Existing pet progress and custom companions automatically restore upon login.
sign_in.hint: Logged in previously? Use your original sign-in method to restore your existing pet.

guard.reason: Adds helpful account sync notification on sign-in without breaking any rules.

candidates.score_note: Reassuring account sync copy aligns with past sign-in wins (+4.2%) and addresses 8 support emails, though sign-in drop is low.

candidates.title: Split Layout Photo Upload Interface
candidates.change: Redesign the upload_photos screen into a two-column layout with immediate photo preview feedback on one side and upload controls on the other.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (68.9% conversion, median 89s), and earlier split-layout companion previews yielded an +8.1% lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Background Render Activity Display

candidates.why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s and 3 users reported pets not showing or apps failing to open; explicit background activity info sets expectations.

waiting.hint: Initialization active. Look for your companion on your main screen shortly.

candidates.score_note: Background status display helps reduce high wait-time drops (2336s mean), matching readiness check historical gains (+3.3%).

decisions.title: System Tray Desktop Companion Retrieval Callout

lessons_next: Post-adoption and post-certificate sign-in reordering, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners worked; post-waiting sign-in hurt, while other sync hints showed no clear effect.
Path selection clarity headlines, spotlight layouts, and visual redesigns worked; checklist layouts hurt, while copy simplifications, value refreshes, and time banners showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints worked; 3D trackers, completion timers, sound notifications, and activity displays showed no clear effect.
Companion previews paired with quality guides or split upload layouts worked; compact grids, photo fallback flows, guidelines banners, and mascot stamp redesigns hurt results.

Interactive spawn placement flows and system tray location tips worked; direct controls guides and first interaction tips hurt results, while mascot greetings and docking hints showed no clear effect.

Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive major wins (e.g., interactive spawn placement flow, visual redesigns) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (e.g., mascot stamp redesign, direct controls guide).
